patch.summary: respond.io cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: respond.io pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: respond.io cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price respond.io against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (WhatsApp Business, shared inbox, CRM CTI) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a business phone system — no IVR, queues or PSTN calling product. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Support and growth teams that need WhatsApp plus other messaging channels in one inbox requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a business phone system — no IVR, queues or PSTN calling product

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Platform subscription plus channel/Meta messaging fees create two-layer TCO

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Contact-based (MAC) packaging can surprise teams with bursty conversation volume

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: AI Agents and advanced automation sit on Growth+

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Advanced/Enterprise needed for SSO, multiple workspaces and custom channels
